title: On this day in space! Oct. 29, 1991: NASA's Galileo spacecraft flies by asteroid Gaspra and snaps amazing photos while flying at 18,000 mph
caption:
On October 29, 1991, NASA's Galileo probe flew past Gaspra and delivered humanity's first detailed look at an asteroid. The historic flyby proved that deep-space navigation could intercept small celestial bodies.
